newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela cracker up soon, one cargo cancelled.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela cracker up soon, one cargo cancelled.

text.p: A 55,000 barrel per day (bpd) catalytic cracker in Venezuela's 120,000 bpd El Palito refinery was scheduled to come back on stream on Tuesday, although there were market rumours that it could take longer, Venezuelan oil traders said on Monday.
"I understand the news this morning was that the cracker is coming back tomorrow, but now I'm hearing rumours that it might be a couple more days," said one.
The impact of last week's unexpected shut-down was quite limited, traders said, with just one cargo of reformulated gasoline cancelled. It had been due to load at the end of the month.
A trader said refinery operators Corpoven withdrew from sale a cargo of vacuum gas oil, used as a cracker feedstock, indicating the cracker would be working again soon.
